notes.title: The limbo bardo vacuum and the stars
notes.content:
- Receive the star at the end of a completed level
- collect all stars
- enjoy the new Limbus Bardo Relay Station. Get back in where you want to.

notes.title: New stage
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678553/fb0fff61371a759c6b09956b29135b20a51bf6c2.png[/img]
Now the entrance to the next challenge always appears in the new distribution station at a random location on the remaining platforms. 
The doors to the levels already mastered remain open and the levels can be replayed at any time.

notes.title: New year, new content
notes.content:
- Spiders
- Flame spitter
- Happy Ghost
- Dissolving and rising platforms
- Wine gum blocks for pushing, stacking and jumping on
- Twelve five-second tutorial seconds

notes.title: kRACH Metropolis
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678553/43d3c1a4bfbe9a06dc1f0486437d46509a37da87.jpg[/img]
Ballooni banishes kRACH with the magic black spell. But be careful. You have to hurry as the platforms disappear under your feet. And missed coins are irretrievably lost. This time it's time to try again. Try again in kRACH Metropolis!

notes.title: SharkRocker
notes.content: Introducing the SharkRocker. Keep the SharkRockers at bay with the help of the dark magic shot. Only then can you enter the gate.

notes.title: The first season
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678553/65c3413231c18c4fb2bd9f776338b204cadc46a6.png[/img]

A more varied second level!
A more balanced level of difficulty.
A fairer level design.
Shoot carefully and let your opponents sleep in the right position. 
Move past them.
Get the jewels and coins.

notes.title: Update notes for august 19th
notes.content:
A new element has been introduced in Level 3 - the Labyrinth Level. It is called 'Hidden Entrance Overlay'.
The ELement reveals the game object underneath or clears the way after it was active as a barricade.
Depending on the game class - which is chosen randomly - Ballooni has to hit the element with his spells, collect a certain
number of coins or just get close to the element to trigger it.
The classic digital directional pad of a gamepad/controller is now also supported.
